set.body:
Deliver the targeted measurements required by Q01.2 and H04.2. Establish a baseline before selecting an optimization.

Acceptance criteria

1. Measure the same fixed release with increasing numbers of unrelated datasets, releases and grants. Attempt a 1 GiB stream and retain any limiting failure as a baseline. Record bytes, chunk checks, SQL work and rows, query plans, throughput and service/database resources.
2. Traverse project/catalog pages under the same populations and compare outputs with the authorized reference oracle. Record cold/warm conditions using the existing workload protocol.
3. Measure browser peak memory while hashing a large file and bytes reread on adding one session. Exercise the current inventory/file caps and cancellation with declared results.
4. Preserve timeouts and budget misses. Use the existing H04.1 targets and produce an explicitly scoped baseline usable by the wider qualification harness.

Verification

Versioned workloads, commands, raw observations, query plans, environment, and comparisons with docs/workloads/engineering-v1.json.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: OPS01: Measure authority, paging and intake costs using the frozen workload
